# SKILL.md — Review Test Scripts

## Purpose

Review generated K6 or JMeter test scripts against quality standards and checklists to ensure they are correct, complete, and production-ready before execution.

---

## When to Use

- After scripts have been generated by `generate-k6-scripts` or `generate-jmeter-scripts`
- Before executing any performance test in a shared or production-mirror environment
- When scripts are updated and need re-validation

---

## Do Not Use When

- Scripts have not been generated yet
- The task is to execute tests (use `execute-performance-tests`)

---

## Inputs

### Required
- Generated test scripts (K6 `.js` files or JMeter `.jmx` structure)
- Test scenarios document (for traceability verification)

### Optional
- Previous review report
- CI pipeline configuration

---

## Outputs

- `script-review-report.md` — Review findings per script, with pass/fail verdict and required changes

---

## Workflow

```
Load Knowledge
      │
      ▼
Identify Script Type (K6 or JMeter)
      │
      ▼
Load Tool-Specific Checklist
      │
      ▼
For Each Script:
  Verify Structure
  Verify Load Profile vs Scenario
  Verify Thresholds vs PRD
  Verify Parameterization
  Verify Correlation
  Verify Assertions
  Verify Security (no hardcoded creds)
      │
      ▼
Apply Script Review Standard
      │
      ▼
Populate Review Report Template
      │
      ▼
Self Review
      │
      ▼
Output Review Report
```

## Execution Rules

1. Load all knowledge sources before reviewing
2. Identify tool type (K6 / JMeter) from script content
3. Apply the corresponding tool checklist
4. Cross-reference every threshold against the scenario SLAs
5. Flag every hardcoded value, missing assertion, and missing parameterization
6. Rate each finding: Critical / Major / Minor
7. Provide a pass/fail verdict per script and overall

---

## Decision Rules

| Condition | Action |
|---|---|
| Script type is K6 | Apply K6 scripting standard + K6 checklist |
| Script type is JMeter | Apply JMeter scripting standard + JMeter checklist |
| Hardcoded credentials found | Critical finding — block |
| Missing thresholds | Critical finding — block |
| Missing assertions | Major finding — block |
| Threshold does not match scenario | Major finding — block |
| Minor style issue | Minor finding — recommend fix |
| All critical and major items pass | Verdict: PASS |
| Any critical item fails | Verdict: FAIL — block execution |

## Self Review

Execute `references/script-review-checklist.md` against the review report itself.

---

## Success Criteria

- All scripts reviewed with documented findings
- PASS verdict issued before execution
